purpose: Track recent frontier AI research evidence relevant to AGI/ASI readiness, separating reported or validated progress from hypotheses and under-test research.

evidence_items.title: Reasoning models with tool capabilities
evidence_items.source: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini system card
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use as evidence for governed reasoning and tool-use architecture, not as AGI proof.

evidence_items.title: Long-horizon task completion measurement
evidence_items.source: METR Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks / arXiv:2503.14499
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use task-completion time horizon as a benchmark for agentic progress and regression tracking.

evidence_items.title: Algorithm discovery and optimization with evolutionary coding agents
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use as a research pattern for experiment loops, objective functions, evaluation metrics, and verified optimization.

evidence_items.title: ARC-AGI-2 benchmark for frontier reasoning
evidence_items.source: ARC-AGI-2: A New Challenge for Frontier AI Reasoning Systems / arXiv:2505.11831
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use to evaluate abstraction, few-shot generalization, and limits of current systems.

evidence_items.title: ARC Prize 2025 technical report and refinement loops
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use refinement loops as an experimental method, while recording that current systems remain constrained and not AGI.

evidence_items.title: Automated alignment auditing agents
evidence_items.source: Anthropic Alignment Science: Building and evaluating alignment auditing agents
evidence_items.sheikha_interpretation: Use as evidence for multi-agent research review, red-team loops, and audit aggregation.

principle: ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
